key_insight: IMPACT combines inverter-level cloud dynamics with plant history, solar geometry, and weather to improve probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasts 10–110 minutes ahead.
engineering_relevance: More accurate, calibrated solar generation forecasts could support short-term grid balancing, storage dispatch, and photovoltaic plant operation.
method: Encode four input branches, including inverter dynamics with learned-adjacency graph attention, and fuse them through gated cross-attention.
Augment solar geometry with horizon-weighted cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down signals.
Learn horizon-specific corrections to smart persistence and calibrate quantiles online with kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports performance above all 14 baselines, with forecast skill score 0.2950—0.099 above the next-best model—and positive contributions from every branch in ablation tests.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify dataset scale or cross-site validation, leaving generalization to other plants and inverter layouts uncertain.
paper_title: IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting
